LamBox.Empty:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Empty
      constructors:

Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Nat
      constructors:
        zero (0 arg(s))
        suc (1 arg(s))

InductionRecursion.List:
  mutual inductive(s):
    List
      constructors:
        [] (0 arg(s))
        _∷_ (2 arg(s))

InductionRecursion.Valid:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Valid
      constructors: mk (3 arg(s))

Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ _ →
                 case<Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0},0> @1 of
                   λ<[]> @0
                   λ<[_]> Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} (@3 @0 @1)

InductionRecursion.step:
  constant declaration:
    body: λ _ _ →
            λ _ _ _ →
              case<InductionRecursion.Valid{0},0> @0 of
                λ<[_, _, _]> Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_ @1 @0
              @1
              @0

InductionRecursion.Trace:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Trace
      constructors:
        [] (0 arg(s))
        _∷_⊣_ (4 arg(s))

InductionRecursion.run:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [0] :=
            0: λ _ → @1 □
            1: λ _ _ →
                 case<InductionRecursion.Trace{0},0> @0 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}
                   λ<[_, _, _, _]> InductionRecursion.step □ (@7 @3 @1) @0

InductionRecursion.test:
  constant declaration:
    body: InductionRecursion.run □
            (InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{1}
               (InductionRecursion.List{0}{1} □ □
                  (InductionRecursion.List{0}{0} □))
               □
               (InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{1} (InductionRecursion.List{0}{0} □) □
                  InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{0}
                  (InductionRecursion.Valid{0}{0} □
                     (InductionRecursion.run □ InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{0})
                     (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0})))
               (InductionRecursion.Valid{0}{0} □
                  (InductionRecursion.run □
                     (InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{1} (InductionRecursion.List{0}{0} □) □
                        InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{0}
                        (InductionRecursion.Valid{0}{0} □
                           (InductionRecursion.run □ InductionRecursion.Trace{0}{0})
                           (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}))))
                  (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1}
                     (Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{1} Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}))))

InductionRecursion..extendedlambda1:
  constant declaration:
    body: μrec [1] :=
            0: λ _ → @1 □
            1: λ _ _ →
                 case<InductionRecursion.Trace{0},0> @0 of
                   λ<[]> Agda.Builtin.Nat.Nat{0}{0}
                   λ<[_, _, _, _]> InductionRecursion.step □ (@7 @3 @1) @0

InductionRecursion.Act:
  mutual inductive(s):
    Act
      constructors: inc (0 arg(s))
main program: [InductionRecursion.test]
